summary: --kv-cache-dtype fp8 reaches the MiMo target and MTP attention layers
details: The MiMo target decoder and native MTP layers now receive the cache configuration, so an FP8 KV request allocates FP8 pages instead of BF16 and keeps scale calibration.
Global layers keep full attention: the model-wide sliding-window fallback is cleared on a copy of the configuration for them.
